decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing various control cards such as Snuff Out and Orcish Bowmasters to remove threats from the opponent. It also includes cards like Natural Order and Gaea's Cradle to generate powerful creatures quickly and overwhelm the opponent. The deck incorporates a variety of lands and mana accelerants, such as Noble Hierarch and Birds of Paradise, to ensure consistent mana production. Additionally, the inclusion of Fiend Artisan and Elvish Reclaimer allows for flexibility in creature searches and graveyard manipulation. Overall, this deck aims to control the board while setting up powerful plays with its creatures.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire deck in one turn. It utilizes various tutors like Goblin Engineer and Urza's Saga to find the combo pieces efficiently. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast to protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Goblin Welder and Fury provide additional utility and protection. By efficiently executing the combo and disrupting the opponent, this deck aims to secure victory through a powerful and streamlined strategy.

This deck focuses on using powerful discard spells and fast mana like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to quickly put key creatures like Worldgorger Dragon or Sheoldred, the Apocalypse into the graveyard. Utilizing cards like Entomb and Animate Dead, the deck aims to reanimate these creatures and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats early in the game. The One Ring serves as a win condition by making the opponent discard their hand, while Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional utility. The deck also has disruption with Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive early creature plays like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting their game plan with counter spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland, while also generating card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble. Overall, the deck seeks to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy while also having the tools to disrupt the opponent's plans and gain incremental advantage.

This black and white aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Samwise the Stouthearted. The deck utilizes Aether Vial to cheat out creatures and manipulate the board, with key cards like Palace Jailer and Recruiter of the Guard providing additional value. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble gives the deck additional card advantage and information, while the mana base is designed to support both aggressive early plays and disruptive late-game interactions with cards like Karakas and Wasteland.

This deck utilizes the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's deck all at once. It includes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to manipulate artifacts, while also running disruptive spells like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to control the board. The deck aims to set up the combo as quickly as possible while using fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Mox Opal. With the ability to tutor for key pieces with Urza's Saga and Ancient Tomb for ramp, this deck is designed to win quickly and efficiently.

This Dark Depths combo deck aims to quickly assemble the Dark Depths-Thespian Stage combo to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token and win the game. The deck includes multiple ways to find and protect the combo pieces, such as Green Sun's Zenith, Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, and Sylvan Safekeeper. Additionally, the deck features disruptive elements like Mox Diamond, Minsc & Boo, and Endurance to control the game and prevent opponents from interfering with the combo. The main focus is on efficiently assembling the combo and protecting it to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to establish a strong board presence early in the game using fast mana sources like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb, along with mana acceleration cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal. Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void disrupt the opponent's mana base while cards like Archon of Emeria and Fury provide aggressive threats. The deck aims to apply pressure quickly with creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Caves of Chaos Adventurer, while utilizing removal spells like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Forth Eorlingas! to control the board and secure the win.

This Aggro - Death's Shadow Legacy deck focuses on aggressively deploying Death's Shadow and leveraging its powerful abilities to control the game. The deck includes cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze for disruption, while also utilizing cards like Reanimate and Brazen Borrower for additional threats and flexibility. The deck aims to quickly reduce its own life total to make Death's Shadow as powerful as possible, while also utilizing efficient removal like Fatal Push and Dismember to deal with opposing threats. With a mix of disruption and powerful threats, this deck aims to pressure opponents and control the game.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play and protect Death's Shadow, a powerful creature that becomes stronger as your life total decreases. The deck utilizes a combination of disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will, alongside powerful removal like Fatal Push and Reanimate, to control the board while applying pressure with Death's Shadow and other threats like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters. By efficiently managing your life total and disrupting your opponent's game plan, you aim to overwhelm them with powerful creatures and spells before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly setting up Death's Shadow as a powerful attacker by manipulating your life total and using cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt your opponent's game plan. It also includes aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Dauthi Voidwalker to pressure your opponent. The deck prioritizes countering spells with Force of Will and Daze to protect your threats and using efficient removal like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to deal with opposing creatures. Wasteland is included to disrupt opponent's mana base and gain tempo advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly casting Cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with threats. By utilizing creatures like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cheat out powerful spells for free. With cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation, the deck can protect its game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection against various strategies. Overall, this deck aims to aggressively cascade into powerful spells while maintaining control and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to use efficient card draw and counterspells to control the game, while also utilizing aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent. This UR Tempo deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Wasteland and Force of Will, while also dealing direct damage with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. Overall, this deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence and maintaining control of the game tempo to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use low-cost, evasive creatures like Changeling Outcast and Ingenious Infiltrator to quickly attack the opponent and trigger the abilities of Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow. With cards like Retrofitter Foundry and Moon-Circuit Hacker, the deck can generate additional value from artifacts and equipments. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Faithless Looting, Entomb, and Grief. These creatures can then be reanimated using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead, allowing the player to bring out massive threats early in the game. The deck also includes disruption cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize to help protect the combo and slow down the opponent. This deck aims to win through explosive graveyard-based combos and overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Cephalid Coliseum, Careful Study, and Golgari Grave-Troll to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures. This allows for powerful combos with cards like Bridge from Below, Narcomoeba, and Ichorid to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces. Overall, the strategy is to quickly dredge through the deck to create a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan.
